plan.title: Yeh Volcano Neeli Aag Kyun Ugalta Hai? 🌋
plan.description_intro: Indonesia ke is anokhe volcano complex mein blue fire aur acidic crater lake dikhti hai. Jaaniye Kawah Ijen ke is anokhe phenomenon ke baare mein.
plan.narration: Indonesia ke East Java mein maujood Ijen volcano complex duniya bhar mein behad mashhoor hai. Yeh jagah apne electric blue fire, acidic crater lake aur sulfur mining ke liye jaani jaati hai. Raat ke andhere mein yahan sulfur ki vajah se neeli aag chamakti dikhai deti hai, jo behad anokhi lagti hai. Iske alawa, yahan ka vishal acidic crater lake aur sulfur mining is jagah ko aur bhi hairatangez banate hain. Nature ka yeh roop sach mein lajawab hai!

Summary: The Ijen volcano complex is a group of composite volcanoes located on the border between Banyuwangi Regency and Bondowoso Regency of East Java, Indonesia. It is known for its blue fire, acidic crater lake, and labour-intensive sulfur mining.
